newsitem.title: UK: London stocks end lower amid rate, sterling woes.
newsitem.headline: London stocks end lower amid rate, sterling woes.

text.p: UK stocks snapped a three-day winning streak on Wednesday, shrugging off fresh Wall Street gains as investors fretted about interest rates, inflation and the impact of sterling strength on company earnings.

The FTSE 100 index closed down 15.3 points at 3,962.8 in modest volume of around 635 million shares, with decliners in a two-to-one majority. National Power helped lead the decline, down 17-1/2p at 435-1/2 after disappointing earnings.
Dealers said they saw little scope for the UK market to shake off its lethargy in the short term, even if Wall Street continued to set new record highs.
